# Anthony Dake

> Session drummer based in Columbus, Ohio. Live drums and studio sessions for independent artists, festivals, and theater. ~405 documented performances and ~52 record credits since 2017.

## What I do

- **Live drums** — touring, festival mainstage, club shows, theater pit. Available for tour-prep, fly-dates, and recurring local work.
- **Session drums** — in-person and remote studio sessions. Live drum performance and drum programming both available.

## Background

- Drum Corps International tours with Blue Knights (2017, 2018, World Class)
- Winter Guard International with Rhythm X (2020, Independent World) and Dojo Percussion
- DCI Open Class with Shadow Drum & Bugle Corps
- Marching band, jazz ensemble, percussion ensemble through high school and college
- 5+ years of weekly church drumming growing up
